method: Single reference point at CTAO's own officially published array-site coordinate for Paranal (precision 100 m). CTAO-South's planned telescope grid (2 LST + 14 MST + 37 SST in the eventual configuration, per arXiv:2410.21199 and CTAO status reports) has no published individual pad coordinates (checked 2026-09-18); construction was still at an early stage when this was recorded (site page: 'construction and operation' ongoing).
name: CTAO-South array site (reference point)
notes: Individual telescope pad positions are not sourced (the array is planned or under construction); CTAO's own construction-progress or layout pages could supply them once individual pads are surveyed and published.

summary.plain: The Chilean desert site where the southern half of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory is under construction, shown as a single reference point.
